pagetitle: "Architecture"
format: html
---

<!--
This page only shows ARCHITECTURE.md from the repository root, which is the one source:
edit that file, not this page. Its first heading is the page title.

ARCHITECTURE.md marks its diagrams in GitHub's way, which GitHub draws but
Quarto shows as code. The chunk below reads the file as text, marks each
diagram in Quarto's way so Quarto draws it, and puts the result on the page.
It reads only ARCHITECTURE.md, never data, and runs no analysis code.
(Do not write a code fence in this comment: Quarto reads it as one.)
-->

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| eval: true
#| output: asis
if (file.exists("../ARCHITECTURE.md")) {
  architecture <- readLines("../ARCHITECTURE.md", warn = FALSE, encoding = "UTF-8")
  architecture <- sub("^```mermaid\\s*$", "```{mermaid}", architecture)
  cat(architecture, sep = "\n")
} else {
  cat("# Architecture\n\n`ARCHITECTURE.md` has not been written yet.\n")
}
```
